title: Indonesia and Thailand loss probabilities

claims.text: In both modeled years Thailand's probability of a conditional revenue loss exceeds Indonesia's, so on the annual evidence available Thailand shows the higher loss probability each year.

limitations: The evidence packet does not include cumulative two-year (joint) loss probabilities for Indonesia or Thailand; the only cumulative country cell provided is Australia, so the requested cumulative comparison cannot be made from this fixed evidence.
Cumulative probabilities cannot be derived by summing annual probabilities, and no adaptive tool was available to retrieve or compute them.
Probabilities are reported as tool-returned probabilities; no unit-conversion tool was available to render them as percentages, so the conversion is left to the application.
Values are conditional on the assessment's stated ENSO scenario and macroeconomic path; they are not causal identifications and not sovereign default probabilities.
Historical input provenance is incomplete per the manifest; the assessment is marked for inspection only and not recomputable.
